risk_if_not_implemented: Without Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Storage Capacity Alerting, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may become unavailable, degraded or unable to meet demand when required. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Unauthorized Privilege Elevation (R-AC-3), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Alternate Event Logging Capability
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to provide an alternate event logging capability in the event of a failure in primary audit capability.
compensating_control_1.justification: Alternate Event Logging Capability (MON-35) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Event Log Storage Capacity Alerting (MON-10.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Response To Event Log Processing Failures
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to alert appropriate personnel in the event of a log processing failure and take actions to remedy the disruption.
compensating_control_2.justification: Response To Event Log Processing Failures (MON-33) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Event Log Storage Capacity Alerting (MON-10.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
